Alert

Alerts display brief, important messages that attract user attention without interrupting their current task.

Basic Alert

A default alert communicates a neutral notice with the primary color scheme.

This is a default alert message.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert">
    <div class="zak-alert-content">This is a default alert message.</div>
</div>

Color Variants

Use semantic variants to convey the type of message: success, danger, warning, and info.

Success: Your changes have been saved.
Danger: There was a problem with your submission.
Warning: Your session is about to expire.
Info: Version 2.4 is now available.
Primary: Please review the updated terms.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-success">...</div>
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-danger">...</div>
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-warning">...</div>
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-info">...</div>
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-primary">...</div>

Alert with Icon

Add an icon on the leading edge to make the alert more scannable.

Your payment was processed successfully.
Unable to connect to the server. Please retry.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-success">
    <span class="zak-alert-icon">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>
    </span>
    <div class="zak-alert-content">Your payment was processed successfully.</div>
</div>

Alert with Title and Description

Use a title for the headline and the content area for supporting detail.

Browser not supported
Please upgrade to a modern browser for the best experience.
New feature
Dark mode is now available in your account settings.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-warning">
    <span class="zak-alert-icon">...</svg></span>
    <div class="zak-alert-content">
        <div class="zak-alert-title">Browser not supported</div>
        Please upgrade to a modern browser.
    </div>
</div>

Alert with Close Button

Add a dismiss button so users can remove the alert. The demo includes JavaScript to remove it from the DOM.

This alert can be dismissed by clicking the close icon.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-primary" role="alert">
    <div class="zak-alert-content">This alert can be dismissed.</div>
    <button class="zak-alert-dismiss" aria-label="Close alert">&times;</button>
</div>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-alert-dismiss').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.closest('.zak-alert').remove();
    });
});
</script>

Alert with Action Button

Provide a primary action using a button inside the alert content.

Your billing information is out of date.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-danger">
    <div class="zak-alert-content">
        Your billing information is out of date.
        <div style="margin-top:0.75rem;">
            <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-sm zak-btn-danger">Update Billing</button>
            <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-sm zak-btn-soft-danger">Remind me later</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Alert with Link

Use an inline link for a secondary, contextual action.

You can view the full changelog on the documentation site.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-info">
    <div class="zak-alert-content">
        You can view the full changelog on the
        <a href="#" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;">documentation site</a>.
    </div>
</div>

Outlined Alert

Apply an outlined style with a transparent background for a lighter look.

Outlined success alert.
Outlined danger alert.
Outlined warning alert.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-success" style="background-color:transparent;">
    <div class="zak-alert-content">Outlined success alert.</div>
</div>

Filled Alert

Use a strong filled background for maximum emphasis and contrast.

Filled success alert.
Filled danger alert.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-success" style="background-color:var(--zak-color-success);color:#fff;">
    <div class="zak-alert-content">Filled success alert.</div>
</div>

JavaScript

Controlled dismissal with a small script to remove alerts and announce them accessibly.

Click "Dismiss Alert" below to remove this alert.
HTML
// Dismiss an alert
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-alert-dismiss').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var alert = this.closest('.zak-alert');
        alert.hidden = true;
    });
});

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-alert            /* Base alert container */
.zak-alert-success     /* Success variant */
.zak-alert-danger      /* Danger variant */
.zak-alert-warning     /* Warning variant */
.zak-alert-info        /* Info variant */
.zak-alert-primary     /* Primary variant */
.zak-alert-icon        /* Leading icon wrapper */
.zak-alert-title       /* Bold title text */
.zak-alert-content     /* Flexible content area */
.zak-alert-dismiss     /* Close button */

Accessibility

  • Use role="alert" for alerts that demand immediate attention so screen readers announce them.
  • Provide an aria-label on the dismiss button so the close action is announced by assistive technology.
  • Do not rely on color alone to convey meaning; pair color variants with text or an icon.
  • Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) for alert text.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-danger" role="alert">
    <div class="zak-alert-content">An error occurred.</div>
    <button class="zak-alert-dismiss" aria-label="Dismiss alert">&times;</button>
</div>
